name: LimX Dynamics TRON 2 (3-in-1)
summary: A modular research robot with two 7-axis arms, a camera head and swappable walking or wheeled legs, carrying up to 5 kg per arm; sold in German shops.

germany.statusNote: reichelt (38,675 €, about 2 weeks, business customers only), Funduino (38,999 €, 21 working days) and Bipedal (41,934 €, about 4 weeks) sell the 3-in-1 package, all incl. VAT; MegaRobotics quotes on request. Cheaper packages: 2-in-1 legs only, or dual arms only.

priceEur.note: 3-in-1 EDU at Funduino, incl. VAT, read 2026-11-06. Bipedal 41,934 € incl. VAT; Reichelt 38,675 € last read 2026-10-20.

germany.leadTime: about 2 weeks (Reichelt); 21 working days (Funduino); about 4 weeks (Bipedal)

sellers.note: Price and availability on request ("Verfügbarkeit anfragen"). Calls itself an official distributor; not verified with LimX.

specs.label: Load capacity
specs.conditions: flat-ground walking; 20 kg when climbing stairs

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: waist RGBD camera, IMU; head and wrist RGBD cameras with dual arms

specs.label: End effector
specs.value: gripper (20 N, 85 mm opening) or dexterous hand

specs.label: Software
specs.value: SDK, Python and C++, ROS1/ROS2, simulator

notes: Research and education platform; arms, soles and wheeled legs are swappable modules.
Which end effector (gripper or dexterous hand) the shop packages include is not stated.
The 3-in-1 package ships with two-finger grippers (LimX packing list); it does not include the Mobile Manipulation Expansion Kit.

evidence.note: Proof of concept at reduced scale, reported by LimX; two TRON 2 worked together. Not a site deployment.

openQuestions: LimX's TRON 2 manual says: flat ground with high friction, not waterproof or dustproof; for stairs the wheeled legs are recommended, the soles carry "a high risk of tipping over".
